target_customer: US importers that pay customs duties
problem: Importers overpay duties and misclassify goods as tariff rules change, and recovering refunds is manual.
business_model: B2B software audits and classification tools, pricing not found; early access

founders.name: Pushkar Lanka
founders.background_notes: YC page: engineering manager at Plaid running privacy and risk engineering; earlier an early engineer on Meta blockchain (Libra/Novi). Education not listed.

competitors.name: Zonos Classify
competitors.what: AI HS and HTS classification mainly for ecommerce landed cost

technical_complexity.rationale: Classification with cited reasoning and entry audits need tariff domain data and accuracy, moderate for LLM tooling.

defensibility.rationale: Methods are replicable and customs software is competitive; durable edge would need audit data and broker partnerships.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Caspian publicly launched a customs and duty refund product on July 29 2025, after founding.

market_need_then: The founder cites over $200B of US duties paid in 2025 amid shifting tariff rules, company claim; tariff turbulence raised audit demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses usetrava.com with a use prefix, not exact name .com; other firms named Trava exist (a 2021 cyber risk company, a DeFi protocol).

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, focused on the importer margin

branding.brand_signature: Protect your margin on every import

brand_strength.rationale: Shares the name with other Trava companies and the searches showed no brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Trava is a one person Winter 2025 YC company aimed at customs duty audits for US importers during a period of tariff turbulence. No exit or shutdown was found. Funding is not publicly reported and the site shows early access products, so traction cannot be judged and competitors such as Caspian arrived in July 2025.
notes: No funding found for this Trava; the $3.5M 2021 Trava and the iCustoms $2.2M seed are different companies. Competitor Zonos has no dated source.
